title: Plotly Interactive Features MicroSim
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Data Science
description: Practice the eight interactive features of a real Plotly chart (hover, zoom, pan, box select, lasso select, reset, download, and legend toggling) while a tracker ticks off each one as you use it.

learningObjectives: Students will be able to use the hover, zoom, pan, box select, lasso select, reset, download, and legend features of a Plotly chart to inspect a dataset.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Guided practice with a task checklist that verifies each action
keyQuestions: What can you learn from a tooltip that you cannot read from the axes?
How does hiding a group from the legend help when clusters overlap?
What is the difference between zooming and panning?
When would selecting points be more useful than zooming in on them?
commonMisconceptions: Interactivity has to be programmed for each chart (Plotly adds these features to every chart).
Zooming changes the data (it only changes the axis ranges, and a double-click restores them).
A hidden group has been deleted (clicking the legend entry again brings it back).
Pan and zoom are the same thing (panning keeps the scale and moves the view, zooming changes the scale).
assessmentOpportunities: On a new Plotly chart, students demonstrate each of the eight features on request and explain how they would find the exact value of one point and isolate one group.
